elements.description:
A dry run of an action against a policy set: the decision, the rule that decided it, the reason and a step-by-step
rule trace. Nothing executes.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the form's name

properties.name: description
properties.description: One line under the heading

properties.name: action
properties.description: The action to try, in words or as a tool call, e.g. "Send the Q3 report to an external address"

properties.name: ruleClass
properties.description: The id of the picked rule class; unset picks the first

properties.name: context
properties.description: Optional context the rules can read, e.g. "amount: 4,800 · recipient: outside the company"

properties.name: ruleClasses
properties.default: [ { id: "read", label: "Read", description: "Looks something up; changes nothing" }, { id: "write", label: "Write", description: "Creates or changes records" }, { id: "communicate", label: "Communicate", description: "Sends something to a person or another system" }, { id: "spend", label: "Spend", description: "Moves money or commits to a cost" }, { id: "delete", label: "Delete", description: "Removes something that may not come back" }, ]
properties.description: The rule classes to pick from

properties.name: examples
properties.description: Ready-made actions shown as chips above the form; [] hides them

properties.name: evaluate
properties.description: Runs the dry run: return the result, or a promise of it. Nothing in the element executes the action

properties.name: result
properties.description: The result shown – set by a run, or by the app (after preventing tc-simulate)

properties.name: decisionLabels
properties.description: The decisions' names, merged over the defaults (Allow, Needs approval, Deny, Hard stop)

properties.name: actionLabel
properties.description: The action field's label

properties.name: actionPlaceholder
properties.description: The action field's placeholder

properties.name: classLabel
properties.description: The rule class field's label

properties.name: contextLabel
properties.description: The context field's label; the field is optional

properties.name: contextPlaceholder
properties.default: "Anything the rules should know – amount, recipient, environment"
properties.description: The context field's placeholder

properties.name: simulateLabel
properties.description: The Simulate button's text

properties.name: requiredLabel
properties.description: Shown when Simulate is pressed with no action

properties.name: errorLabel
properties.description: Shown when `evaluate` throws or its promise rejects

properties.name: dryRunLabel
properties.description: The reminder next to Simulate that nothing runs

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-input-change
events.description: The action, the rule class or the context changed, or an example filled them ({ input, field }: PolicySimInputChange); cancelable – prevented, the fields keep their values

events.name: tc-simulate
events.description: Simulate was pressed with a described action ({ input }: PolicySimRun); cancelable – prevented, `evaluate` isn't called and the app sets `result` itself

events.name: tc-result
events.description: `evaluate` returned a result ({ input, result }: PolicySimResultEvent)

functions.name: defaultPolicyRuleClasses
functions.description: The rule classes used when the page gives none

functions.name: defaultPolicyDecisionLabels
functions.description: The decisions' names used when the page gives none

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the form's name

props.name: value
props.description: The action, rule class and context – controlled when given

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The inputs on mount when `value` isn't controlled

props.name: onChange
props.description: A field changed or an example filled the form

props.name: evaluate
props.description: Runs the dry run: return the result, or a promise of it

props.name: result
props.description: The result shown – controlled when given; otherwise the last result `evaluate` returned

props.name: onSimulate
props.description: Simulate was pressed. Return false to skip `evaluate` and set `result` yourself

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
